name: Seven
overview: The number seven in Scripture signifies completeness and divine order, as demonstrated when God rested on the seventh day, blessing and sanctifying it after creation (Genesis 2:2-3). This sacred number also appears in God's instructions to Noah, commanding seven pairs of clean animals to be taken into the ark and marking a period of seven days before the flood began (Genesis 7:2, 7:4, 7:10). Furthermore, after the flood, Noah waited another seven days before sending out the dove, highlighting the ongoing significance of seven as a symbol of God's sovereign timing and covenantal faithfulness (Genesis 8:10).
